limitations: Algorithmic array bytes are not independently measured DRAM traffic.
Capture-time command GPU timing and replay timing describe different executions.
GPU frequency, background activity and sampling coverage are not fixed.
Native counter metadata and units are retained without normalizing limiter percentages.
Two trials per variant characterize this capture only; small differences do not establish a portable speedup.
The native external-memory counter can include memory external to GPU without proving DRAM traffic.
Native launch limiter includes stalls launching and must not be interpreted as pure thread-launch overhead.
Unobserved counter leaves retain null metadata; the debugger info command otherwise reports default zero values.
